name: Network
description: All network messages are identified by a 64-bit hash of their name. This hash is automatically computed when using `Network.send` and `Network.receive`, so you don't need to worry about it unless you're handling the low-level `Network.message` event directly.
Every network message is limited to a maximum payload size of 1 megabyte (1,048,576 bytes).
All data is sent on the reliable channel.

functions.name: send
functions.description: Sends a buffer of data to a specified player as a specific network message.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: The buffer of data to send.

parameters.name: messageName
parameters.description: The name of the network message to send.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player to send the data to.

functions.name: send
functions.description: Sends a buffer of data to the server as a specific network message.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: The buffer of data to send.

parameters.name: messageName
parameters.description: The name of the network message to send.

functions.name: receive
functions.description: Registers a callback to be called when a specific network message is received from a player.

parameters.name: messageName
parameters.description: The name of the network message to listen for.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: The callback to be called when the message is received.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player who sent the message.

functions.name: receive
functions.description: Registers a callback to be called when a specific network message is received from the server.

parameters.name: messageName
parameters.description: The name of the network message to listen for.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: The callback to be called when the message is received.

functions.name: getMessageNameHash
functions.description: Gets the hash of a network message name.

parameters.name: messageName
parameters.description: The name of the network message.

returns.name: hash
returns.description: The 64-bit hash of the network message name as a string.

events.name: message
description: Fired when a network message is received from the server.
- Network messages are identified by a hash, not by name.
- Use `Network.receive` to register callbacks for specific messages.

parameters.name: messageNameHash
parameters.description: The 64-bit hash of the received network message as a string.

events.name: message
description: Fired when a network message is received from a player.
- Network messages are identified by a hash, not by name.
- Use `Network.receive` to register callbacks for specific messages.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: The player who sent the message.

parameters.name: messageNameHash
parameters.description: The 64-bit hash of the received network message as a string.
